Thank you, Ruth. I've confirmed your identity and found the issue.

Your earlier support ticket (TK-881) for order Q-7690 from Big Slice Pizza promised a $6.50 account credit for the missing garlic knots. That credit had not been applied, so I've now added **$6.50 to your account**. Your new credit balance is $6.50, and you can use it on future orders.

I'm sorry it took this long to show up. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Oh, I see. I was sure it was $10, not $6.50. I don't have the ticket in front of me, so I can't say for certain, but I'd really like to know how they got to that number. Could you check the ticket again for me?

I checked ticket TK-881 again, and it says: "Agent promised $6.50 account credit for the missing garlic knots, to be applied within 24 hours." The ticket records no other amount.

The $6.50 matches the price of the garlic knots on your order. The ticket doesn't say how the amount was calculated, so I can't tell you more than that.

The $6.50 credit is now on your account, and the balance is $6.50. Is there anything else I can help with?

Thank you for checking again. I'm not going to argue about the ticket, since I don't have it in front of me. If the record says $6.50 and that matches the garlic knots, then I'll accept that. I just wanted to be sure I wasn't shortchanged.

Could you confirm the $6.50 is on my account now, and that it doesn't expire or get used up somehow before I place my next order?

Yes, the $6.50 is on your account now. The credit balance is $6.50, and it will apply to your next order.

I don't have any information about an expiration date for account credit, so I can't confirm whether it expires. If you want that answered, I can connect you with a human specialist. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, thanks for confirming the $6.50 is on my account and will go toward my next order. I don't need a specialist for that. I'd just like to know it doesn't disappear before I use it, so if you can find that out, I'd appreciate it. Otherwise, I think we're all set for now.

I'm sorry, but my tools don't show whether account credit expires, so I can't find that out for you. Your $6.50 credit is on your account now and will apply to your next order. If you'd like the expiry question answered, just let me know and I can pass it to a human specialist.

Thanks for your patience, Ruth, and enjoy your next order.
Thank you for your help today. I'll go with the $6.50 for now, and I'll keep an eye on it for my next order.
You're welcome, Ruth. Your $6.50 credit is on your account for your next order. Have a great day!
